meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas. doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.mechanism: mTORC2–Akt signalling localises to mitochondria-associated ER membranes and regulates mitochondrial physiology from there.
data.mechanism_beginner: mTORC2 signalling also happens at a specific contact point between mitochondria and another cell structure – proof this pathway works at more than one location in the cell.
data.boundary: Biochemical fractionation and imaging in cell lines; the functional contribution relative to plasma-membrane mTORC2 is not quantified.
